text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and repeated safety claim","quality":"central claim focus","description":"It keeps the argument consistently centered on one main position and supports that position throughout."},{"evidence":"“Driverless cars provide a solution for reckless driving… intoxicated… road rage”","quality":"use of source-based evidence","description":"It draws on relevant ideas from the article and connects them to its own position instead of relying mostly on opinion."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs on intoxicated drivers and reckless drivers","quality":"organizing structure","description":"It divides the argument into distinct points that make the essay easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“With further improvements… could put an end to all automobile wrecks and accidents”","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"It expands claims with explanations of how and why driverless cars might improve safety."},{"evidence":"introductory and concluding framing around a safer future","quality":"essay coherence","description":"It opens and closes in a way that reinforces the same overall argument and gives the piece a more unified shape."}]}
